csv_project_name: CMAR for Livestock Poultry Health Facility Renovations
csv_scope_of_work: Clemson University is soliciting Statements of Qualifications from experienced Construction Manager at Risk (CM-R) firms for the Livestock Poultry Health Renovation Project. The project consists of the renovation of the existing approximately 30,000 square foot Livestock Poultry Health Facility located on Clemson University property in Columbia, South Carolina. The facility serves as a critical animal health, diagnostic, and regulatory service provider for the State of South Carolina and must remain operational throughout all phases of construction. The project includes significant deferred maintenance, infrastructure modernization, and building envelope improvements, and HVAC system replacement and modernization.
